Aaron, saw ServiceTrade just launched Stella, your suite of AI agents aimed at turning operational bottlenecks into revenue.

A launch like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the sales team can cover before the message lands, and that is where early deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ServiceTrade off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Aaron, quick follow-up for ServiceTrade.

Around a launch like Stella, expectations on pipeline usually rise faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ServiceTrade needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Aaron, last bit of proof for ServiceTrade.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ServiceTrade's reply rate likely compares to other vertical-SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a field-service motion? I'll tailor it to ServiceTrade either way.
